subject: emissive holographic scene, not a photographed painted physical object

projectionRoute.reason: Projecting screenshot pixels onto transparent geometry would bake background, bloom, multiple overlapping structures and occlusion into one surface. It would misrepresent the scene from orbit views.
projectionRoute.alternative: Procedural geometry and localized grid/emission fields, compared at a matched reference camera.
projectionRoute.limitation: No exact hidden-side reconstruction or pixel-perfect fidelity claim.

materialEvidence.reason: Synthetic emission and layered scene compositing do not provide separable physical albedo/roughness/normal/AO evidence.
materialEvidence.carrierRoute: Evidence-backed textureless matte-emissive carrier materials; pattern detail is geometric, not removed.
materialEvidence.colors: Numeric palette, alpha and emission remain artistic proposals; only color families are observed.
materialEvidence.requirement: No bitmap surface detail may be added under a textureless declaration; revise applicability if representation changes.
